commentary: Graded each resolved entry over its sweep scope and probed the two that added behaviour. The markdown-it section reader was run against closing-hash headings, a deeper heading inside the section, CRLF line ends, three-space indentation and a heading directly under an HTML tag (swallowed into the HTML block, as GitHub renders it): each matched the requirement as now written. The floor guard accepts a floor of one over a count of one, which is what "at most" buys over "below". The residual range from the commit that added the external return lists eleven files, every one inside some entry's edit record. The full suite and strict validation were green before this pass. The one texture worth carrying forward: the residue check now reads HTML blocks while the shared extractor does not, a deliberate difference the design states, and the first place a future reader might expect the two parses to agree.
